facilities.name: Harris Teeter Perishable Distribution Center Indian Trail NC
facilities.source: Harris Teeter careers/distribution portal lists Indian Trail Perishable + Grocery warehouses; address verified via TruckMap and Union County / Waze listings (6001 W Hwy 74). Historically the company's all-perishables hub for the chain.

facilities.name: Harris Teeter Grocery Distribution Center Indian Trail NC
facilities.source: Harris Teeter careers/distribution portal lists separate Grocery Warehouse at the Indian Trail campus; expanded 317,000 sq ft to handle dry grocery (Supermarket News). Same campus address as perishable DC.

facilities.name: Harris Teeter Distribution Center Greensboro NC
facilities.source: Address verified via TruckMap, Yelp, Waze, county chamber listings (200 Distribution Dr). Historically the chain's frozen + dry grocery depot; added 174,000 sq ft of perishable capacity (Supermarket News). 24/7 distribution operation.
